newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia detains five boats for illegal fishing.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia detains five boats for illegal fishing.

text.p: The Indonesian navy has detained five boats for fishing illegally near the Natuna islands in the South China Sea, the official Antara news agency reported on Thursday.
Commander of the navy's western fleet, Rear Admiral Achmad Sutjipto, said the boats were recently caught during patrols around the islands, some 1,100 km (680 miles) north of Jakarta.
The boats' crew were all from Thailand, he said.
Crew of three of the five vessels, which were all flying Indonesian flags, had been remanded in custody. The others were being processed by the navy, Achmad was quoted by the news agency as saying.

Last month the navy expelled 50 Chinese fishing boats from waters near eastern Irian Jaya province. On Monday this week, 24 boats from Taiwan and Thailand were caught illegally fishing off eastern Indonesia.
